diagnostic: Round 2 GREEN. ui-bare-pages 45/45 scenarios (the 9 repair-round rows plus the 36 that had to stay green). Keep-green all verified on the final tree: keyboard 9/9, kb 38/38, us-b04 4/4, canzan-theme-system 30/30, us-06 44/44, us-11 10/10, keycloak-sso 46/46, cargo test -p foundry-app, cargo xtask check-arch, cargo xtask smoke :: all gates green. Commit e74cda9. ONE route, ONE row source, THREE renders. Body still from Sec-Fetch-Dest; frame from who is asking (ADR-BARE-PAGES-002). The frame is assembled only after the store still answers for her: signed_in_user gives the session, then store::resolve_active_workspace, the shipped membership-joined resolution, must answer Some. A session cookie outlives the account, and nav_identity would NOT have caught this, because it joins users and workspaces by id and both rows survive the membership delete the oracle performs; it would have returned the real workspace name for a removed member, or the neutral there / your workspace fallback, which the oracle refuses by name. Ok(None) and Err both take the card arm, fail-closed to the public page that names nobody and refuses nothing, so the route stays PUBLIC and who may open it is unchanged. Signed-in frame assembled exactly as projects.rs show_create_form does: one csrf::ensure_csrf_cookie mint, nav::resolve_is_instance_admin, NavContext::home_for with that same token (home_for, not a section of its own, because the shortcut page owns no primary rail member, so exactly one member stays marked and no new nav rule appears), and the mint's Set-Cookie carried out through csrf::response_with_optional_cookie. Both page arms keep class=keyboard-help with no role and no aria-label, now a recorded promise rather than my own finding. Cache contract set in ONE place beside the decisions: Vary: Sec-Fetch-Dest, Cookie on every arm, Cache-Control: no-store on the page arms only; the fragment arm stays keepable because its body is identical for every client of that arm and carries no identity. The chip resolved no rule anywhere, so .state[data-state] takes the keycap pairing with an OPAQUE --cz-bg-2, the --cz-line hairline, its own radius and --cz-text glyphs; ::file-selector-button takes the shipped secondary presentation, which the earlier font: inherit on the input could not reach because that button is a box the browser owns. IssuePage.status_slug dropped. CHANGELOG wording corrected to the shipped behaviour for all three points. Both ADR-002 citations repointed to ADR-BARE-PAGES-002. Stylesheet re-hashed foundry.e770ce20.css -> foundry.8a68a324.css with base.html, VENDOR.md and the three lib.rs assertions in the same commit. No refactor was taken this round; the round-1 prefactor (586939d) already owns the rows. FLAKE, resolved not retained: the keycloak-sso timing side-channel scenario failed once at 260ms against a 150ms budget, with absolute argon2 medians of 2267ms and 2007ms and a 900ms spread inside one arm, in a VM shared with three other projects; it passed 46/46 on an immediate re-run on the same tree and this change touches no auth path. cargo fmt --all was run in the VM and rewrote crates/foundry-app/src/keyboard.rs; that file was copied back with limactl copy before the commit, and smoke then passed on the committed tree. typesafe: unavailable - TYPESAFE_API_KEY is not set, so no Jev call was made. The one open choice, which read distinguishes a session the store can no longer answer for, was settled mechanically by reading nav_identity's own SQL against the oracle's DELETE, not by preference.
